summary: Finds the position of a slide in a presentation.
description: The slides are compared by their object id, so a slide read earlier is still recognised. A slide that belongs to another presentation, or has since been removed, gives `null`.
The presentation comes first, as it does in [`getSlideByIndex`](getSlideByIndex.md), so the two lookups read the same way round.
returns: the zero-based position, or `null` when the slide is not there.
